programme.title: Bled White
programme.desc: The dead feast on human flesh and stop at nothing for it. The living, confined to the dark corners of the world, must do what it takes to survive.

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: Pol is a teenager with a seemingly calm life. He lives with his brother, and is still in high school. However, Pol has a secret: Deerhoof, a cuddly teddy bear who thinks, moves around, and with whom he shares his best moments. Life goes on as normal until the arrival of Ikari, an enigmatic student who seems to be hiding something.

programme.title: Bartleby
programme.desc: A clueless boss has no idea what to do with his mundane office worker whose refusal of duties only gets worse each passing minute. Star studded cast!!

programme.title: Beeper
programme.desc: A doctor must follow the instructions on a drug dealer's beeper to rescue his kidnapped son. Starring Harvey Keitel, Joey Lauren Adams, Ed Quinn

programme.title: Bait
programme.desc: Two women with aspirations of opening their own business borrow money from a loan shark, but when his terms turn violent, they're forced into bloody retaliation.

programme.title: Apotheosis
programme.desc: Darwin and his girlfriend Christine get into an angry fight one night. The next day she is found dead in a dumpster. Darwin is accused of the crime. But what really happened? It could be only his shadow knows the truth.

programme.title: Anthem
programme.desc: A young writer and his attractive wife looking to climb the social ladder move to an affluent area outside of Scottsdale AZ. Little do they know...Once you say yes... it's hard to say no later.

programme.title: Ashes
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved wife in a devastating fire, Jonathon Soter's life is in ruins. Drinking to excess and barely holding down his job as a teacher, he's a man lost with nothing to live for. But the sudden news that the boy who killed his wife, Donald McKinley, has been released early from prison, brings monumental change for Soter and gives him a new motivation. He begins a journey where he hopes to find his tormentor, to find an answer and perhaps to ultimately find redemption.

programme.title: Alongside Night
programme.desc: In a collapsing near-future U.S., brilliant high-school senior Elliot Vreeland's search for his famous missing economist father and family puts him between an out-of-control federal government and a revolutionary anarchist underground. Starring Kevin Sorbo, Christian Kramme and Reid Cox.

programme.title: Amateur Teens
programme.desc: A group of average students at a secondary school in Zürich wrestle with the average teenager’s needs: love and acceptance. But when the growing influence of social media tosses them into the grown-up world of sexuality and aggression, their needs turn dangerous. What follows is a tragedy that blurs the lines between perpetrator and victim, guilt and innocence.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James The Amazing Randi. Starring James Randi, Alice Cooper and Penn and Teller

programme.title: .357 - Six Bullets For Revenge
programme.desc: On her wedding night, Jade wakes up holding the hand of her dead husband after she narrowly survived a murder attempt by the criminal family she fled from only weeks before. After pawning her wedding ring for a 357 Magnum she goes after the criminals who ruined her life. Starring Fred Williamson, William Katt, Laurie Love

programme.title: 6 Degrees of Hell
programme.desc: Six individuals are caught up in a supernatural perfect storm, as an evil lays claim to one of them while threatening to tear apart the soul of a small Pennsylvania town. Starring Corey Feldman, Brian Anthony Wilson and Nicole Cinaglia

programme.title: Race Across The World S02 E09 - Extraordinary Journey, Ordinary People Endure NB
programme.desc: Over 54 days, five pairs of ordinary Brits took on the challenge of a lifetime and attempted to travel, at ground level, the entire length of Latin America: from Mexico City to Ushuaia, Argentina, the most southerly city in the world – with no planes, no credit cards and no smartphones in sight. They came across extreme weather, states of emergency, evacuations, challenging budgets as well as life-changing encounters, incredible acts of generosity and dramatic landscapes. Most of all, they had to survive each other.

programme.title: Epic Trails S01 E02 - Australia's Northern Territory
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads down under to explore the Larapinta Trail and Kakadu National Park.

programme.title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers S01 E06 - New Orleans, LA NB
programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee head to New Orleans where Creole and Vietnamese flavors merge, modern Israeli food finds a home and a historic cocktail culture gives rise to tasty hangover cures.

programme.desc: Why Germans are so Crazy About Bread. Pule: Is This the World's Most Expensive Cheese? Tidal Fishing on the French Island Île d’Oléron Afternoon Tea: A British Institution. Powdered Beer: Hit or Miss? From Refugee to Top Chef - Victoire Gouloubi.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E114 - Vegan Sausage, Khinkali, Olive Oil

programme.desc: A French Culinary Classic: Ratatouille. Three Kinds of Schnitzel An Italian classic: Spaghetti alle Vongole. The Bagel’s Illustrious History. Hungarian Goulash Cream Tea: A Popular British Tradition.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E116 - Greek Street Food, Coffee, Köttbullar
programme.desc: A Coffee Tour of Trieste. Why the British love their 'Sunday Roast'. The Secret to a German Pretzel. To our taste: the right sauce for the right pasta. Köttbullar, a Swedish National Dish. Greek street food classic.

programme.title: Departures S03 E02 - Russia - The Bull Of Winter
programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.title: Descending S01 E04 - The Emerald Sea
programme.desc: Scott brings Ellis and the Descending team home to Canada for some cold-water diving off Vancouver Island. Scott and Ellis make friends with some questionable creatures and then pilot a jet at 80ft below the surface. Above the water, the team is put to work preparing a ship for scuttling.

programme.title: Scottish Islands With Ben Fogle S01 E03 - Northern Outer Hebrides
programme.desc: Ben Fogle returns to Scotland’s sacred Outer Hebrides, exploring Harris and Lewis in a personal journey shaped by spirituality, nature, and community. From ancient rituals to modern faiths, he uncovers transformative island experiences and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Into The Rising Sun E01 - Fugu
programme.desc: Global traveller, Scott Wilson, returns to Japan to tour around by motorcycle, and experience the country's rich cultural and cuisine offerings found off the typical tourist trail.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E07 - Potato
programme.desc: Lauren explores the culinary possibilities of the humble potato. She demonstrates how to make perfect crispy potato wedges, a hearty potato and vegetable curry, and homemade gnocchi recipe that is hard to beat.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E08 Tofu
programme.desc: Discover the delicious and nutritious world of tofu with Lauren as she experiments with various textures and flavors, pushing the soybean to its limits to create amazing dishes like Scramble tofu and the sweet-spicy delight of Tahu Gejrot.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E117 - Irish Stew, Licorice, Mozzarella, Khachapuri
programme.desc: The best sommelier in the world. Buffalo Mozzarella from Italy: how the Original is Made. The secret of licorice. Ireland’s National Dish: Irish Stew. Cantuccini – crunchy and delicious. Khachapuri – a Georgian specialty.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E118 - Cinnamon Buns, Cevapcici, Żurek, Fries
programme.desc: Balkan street food: Iconic Cevapcici rolls. Su Filindeu Noodles. Cinnamon Buns - Sweden’s favorite pastry. Belgian fries - Crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. A Polish specialty: Żurek sour rye flour soup.

programme.title: Euromaxx On Vacation E92 - Tips For A Visit To Seville
programme.desc: Tips for a Visit to Seville. How to Impress in Italy! Discover the Darss Peninsula. Vienna, the world’s most livable city. Discover Gdańsk in Poland.

programme.title: Euromaxx On Vacation E93 - Secrets From Riga To Mont Saint-Michel
programme.desc: One Day in Riga: Insider Tips. An Amusement Park Without Electricity. Discover the German City of Wuppertal. Albania: You Can't Trust Books, You Have to Go There!. The Secrets of Mont Saint-Michel

programme.title: Euromaxx on Vacation E51 - Trip to Barcelona, Davos, Hamburg
programme.desc: A Trip to Barcelona Visiting Hamburg Wieliczka Salt Mine Rennes, the Capital of Brittany Davos: Economic Forum and Ski Paradise A Night in a Harbor Crane

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E05 - Great Britain At Its Best
programme.desc: Decide with us whether London really is as beautiful as the pictures on Instagram. Find out why Harry Potter is so important to Edinburgh, meet the only four-legged mayor in the world and have an afternoon tea to make you feel like a real Brit.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E06 - Netherlands At Its Best
programme.desc: What would the Netherlands be without its tulips, bicycles, museums and Gouda cheese? Admire the most beautiful tulip blossoms, cycle through the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam, find out what the bridges in a suburb of Rotterdam have to do with euro notes and savour a piece of delicious Gouda cheese with us.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E07 - Scandinavia At Its Best
programme.desc: Admire the fjords of Norway on a boat trip, find out whether Copenhagen is really as cool as Instagram claims and discover the charm of Helsinki's modern architecture.

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E06 - Cairns
programme.desc: In this episode, we discover where Australia begins by embarking down the Mulgrave River on an exclusive day tour out to the Frankland Islands. Next, we explore a bit of cultural history by spearfishing alongside the Daintree Rainforest. Then we go full eco-touristic while visiting a revered sanctuary of wildlife, Hartley's Crocodile Adventure! Ultimately, we arrive at Fitzroy Island Retreat. Enough said!

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E07 - Hawaii
programme.desc: In this episode, we pursue the spirit of ambition while discovering Hawaii's immortal culture! From walking the hallowed grounds of Hilo Coffee Mill to witnessing the reinvention of traditions at Old Lahaina Luau- this episode represents the best of what is to be expected while traveling wide-eyed through paradise!

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E08 - The Island Hawaii
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit The Island of Hawaii better known as “The Big Island.” Here, we explore the history and geography of the islands, learn how to Hula Dance, visit a tranquil secluded retreat, learn the art of lei-making, and have some sea and land adventures!

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E09 - Pacific Cuisine
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the taste of pacific cuisine. From Hawaiian fusion and the beloved coffee bean to New Zealand oysters and tropical fish, Didiayer shares a variety of tastes around the pacific rim.

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E10 - Pacific Culture
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore culture old and new through a variety of unique destinations. Whether it be doing the Haka with a Maori tribe, weaving alpaca hair, or getting the real story behind the Hawaiian Luau, this episode dives in to the customs that bring people together.

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E11 - Pacific Adventure
programme.desc: In this episode, we step out and in to nature to explore what adventure awaits. Amongst rappelling, zip-lining, horseback riding, snorkeling with dolphins and feeding crocodiles there is hardly a moment to catch your breath!

programme.title: Americas Treasures Musical Cities E02 - New Orleans
programme.desc: The episode highlights New Orleans as a world-class "Creative City of Music" and the birthplace of jazz.

programme.title: Americas Treasures Musical Cities E03 - Miami
programme.desc: We highlight Miami as a vibrant, tropical hub for Latin American music, specifically focusing on its salsa scene. The series explores how Miami’s unique cultural landscape, heavily influenced by Cuban and other Latin American traditions, shapes its distinct musical identity.

programme.title: Americas Treasures Musical Cities E04 - Chicago, Illinois
programme.desc: We explore Chicago as a legendary music hub. The episode likely showcases the city's rich musical heritage, which includes its influential blues, jazz, and house music scenes, highlighting key venues and artists that defined the city's sound.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation S01 E03 - Las Vegas Navada NB
programme.desc: An adventure-focused episode highlighting the family taking in the vast landscapes, hiking, or exploring the, natural wonder of the National Park.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation S01 E04 - Washington D.C. NB
programme.desc: The family explores the nation's capital, visiting iconic monuments, museums, and historical sites, offering an educational yet fun, experience.

programme.title: Lucky In Love S01 E01 - Alana and Josh in Fort Worth NB
programme.desc: Alana and her boyfriend, Josh, visit Fort Worth, Texas, letting fate guide their itinerary. The coin toss leads to unexpected and exciting experiences in the city.

programme.title: The Da Vinci List Chefs E01
programme.desc: Meet the modern culinary artists who have transformed their fields.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.desc: "They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?"

programme.desc: A revolutionary and his band take over a small Mexican town. The townspeople begin to take sides over whether to fight him, join forces with him or just try to get along with him.

programme.title: Then There Were Three
programme.desc: US Army personnel patrolling through Italy during World War 2, are being killed off by an unknown German agent posing as a fellow soldier.

programme.title: The Battle Of El Alamein
programme.desc: World war two drama about the 1942 North Africa battle at El Alamein between the Allies and the Axis forces

programme.title: Purple Death From Outer Space
programme.desc: Flash Gordon, Dale Arden and Dr. Zarkov return to the planet Mongo for an antidote to the Purple Death, which wreaking destruction on Earth. However, Ming the Merciless has other plans for them.

programme.title: Alien Contamination
programme.desc: A former astronaut helps a government agent and a police detective track the source of mysterious alien pod spores, filled with lethal flesh-dissolving acid, to a South American coffee plantation controlled by alien pod clones.

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: A deputy sets out to prove that a respected judge, who had once been a criminal, is being framed for crimes committed by a crooked saloon owner.

programme.title: Africa Screams
programme.desc: Two booksellers search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually-impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals.

programme.title: A Quiet Place To Kill
programme.desc: A disillusioned race-car driver plots to kill her ex-husband at the behest of his new wife, but the plan quickly goes awry.

programme.title: Buckskin Frontier
programme.desc: A railroad man and the owner of a freight line battle for control of a crucial mountain pass.

programme.title: Dead Aim
programme.desc: A traveling gravedigger during an (unspecified) war adopts a orphan he finds alone in the desert. After the war with the orphan grown and business slow, the orphan begins to generate business himself by shooting people.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: U.S. marshal John Carruthers observes a robbery and Sheriff Jake thinks he may be the culprit. Meanwhile the town's leading citizen is planning to rob everybody blind.

programme.title: Four of the Apocalypse 1975
programme.desc: In Four of the Apocalypse, director Lucio Fulci delivers a gritty and haunting Spaghetti Western. After a crooked sheriff banishes four misfits—a gambler, a prostitute, a drunk, and a simple-minded man—they journey across a lawless frontier searching for survival and redemption. But their path collides with a sadistic bandit, plunging them into violence, cruelty, and despair. Blending raw brutality with moments of tenderness, this bleak tale explores the struggle for humanity in a world gone savage.

programme.title: Bells Of Rosarita
programme.desc: Sue Farnum inherits a circus, but her dead father's partner is trying to take it away from her. Roy and Bob Nolan are filming a movie on location at the circus. They and a number of other western movie stars come to Sue's aid, putting on a show and catching the bad guys.

programme.title: Man From Music Mountain
programme.desc: When nasty land developers try to bilk honest ranchers who don't know their land holds lots of gold, Gene puts a stop to it.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown (1952)
programme.desc: In Colorado Sundown, Rex Allen stars in a Western adventure of land, greed, and justice on the frontier. When cattlemen and timber interests clash over valuable mountain property, Rex steps in to keep the peace and expose the schemers fueling the feud. With his faithful horse Koko, the comedy of Slim Pickens, and songs that echo across the range, this action-packed tale blends music, mystery, and six-gun justice under the wide Colorado sky.

programme.title: Frontier Pony Express
programme.desc: As Yankee and Rebel forces contend for the allegiance of California, Pony Express rider Roy and his sidekick must round up a pack of villains before Roy can turn his attentions to the girl.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: The heirs of the dying owner of a valuable radium mine are being murdered as a mining engineer tries to uncover the killer and clear his cousin's name.

programme.title: Sheriff of Tombstone
programme.desc: The mayor has sent for a gunslinger who, though appearing to clean up the town, is really to be the mayor's means of taking the town over. When Roy and Gabby arrive in Tombstone, Roy is mistaken for the gunslinger. Just as Roy is ready to expose the mayor, the real gunslinger shows up.

programme.title: One Dollar Too Many 1968
programme.desc: In One Dollar Too Many, three schemers—played by Antonio Sabàto, John Saxon, and Frank Wolff—race each other across the frontier in a madcap chase for stolen loot. Double-crosses, disguises, and comic chaos pile up as each man tries to outwit the others, with greed proving to be the wildest outlaw of all. A playful twist on the Spaghetti Western, this action-packed romp mixes gunfights with sharp humor and larger-than-life characters.

programme.title: The Bushwhackers 1952
programme.desc: In The Bushwhackers, John Ireland stars as a war-weary Confederate soldier who drifts west seeking peace, only to find violence waiting on the frontier. When ruthless land barons use guns and terror to drive settlers from their homes, he’s forced to take up arms once more. With Lon Chaney Jr. and Lawrence Tierney adding menace and intrigue, this tense Western delivers a hard-hitting tale of greed, justice, and a reluctant hero who can’t outrun the fight for what’s right.

programme.title: Honor Of The Range
programme.desc: After Sheriff Ken puts money in the safe, his brother Clem gives Rawhide the combination. With the money gone the disgruntled townsmen make Boots Sheriff and lock up Ken. Clem, now a prisoner of Rawhide, has a change of heart and sends Ken a message with the outlaw's location. Ken escapes by impersonating the saloon entertainer and rides for the hangout.

programme.title: Apache Rose
programme.desc: Roy is an oil prospector. His efforts to get drilling rights on an old Spanish land grant are countered by gamblers from an off-shore gambling boat determined to control the land (and oil) themselves.

programme.title: Dirty Outlaws
programme.desc: An outlaw masquerades as the son of a blind man in order to find a cache of gold located in a vacated town.

programme.title: Django, Kill!
programme.desc: Various factions, including a half-breed bandit, a gang of homosexual cowboys, and a priest, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: In 15th-century France, a gypsy girl is framed for murder by the infatuated Chief Justice, and only the deformed bellringer of Notre Dame Cathedral can save her.

programme.title: Invisible Ghost Starring Bela Lugosi
programme.desc: The town's leading citizen becomes a homicidal maniac after his wife deserts him.

programme.title: It Takes A Thief
programme.desc: A gang leader dumps her criminal boyfriend when he is convicted of robbery, but he recovers the stolen loot once he's released. In retaliation, the gang kidnaps his son and demands the money as ransom.

programme.title: Radio Ranch
programme.desc: Re-edited feature version of serial The Phantom Empire (1935). Singer Gene Autry discovers a race of advanced humans living beneath the earth

programme.title: Nosferatu : A Symphony Of Horror (1922 Colorized)
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: A Boy And His Dog
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a boy who can communicate with his dog telepathically is targeted by a mysterious committee

programme.title: Alias John Law
programme.desc: John Clark (Bob Steele) and his deaf pal, Bootch Collum (Buck Connors), are trailed by U. S. Marshal Lamar Bly (Jack Rockwell), who thinks they are part of The Kootney Kid's (Earl Dwire) gang, which had just held up the stage coach

programme.title: The Fatal Hour Starring Boris Karloff
programme.desc: When Captain Street's best friend Dan Grady is murdered, Street receives help from Chinese detective James Lee Wong and local newspaper reporter Bobbie Logan.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: An investigator from the War Crimes Commission travels to Connecticut to find an infamous Nazi.

programme.title: The Mad Monster
programme.desc: A mad scientist changes his simple-minded handyman into a werewolf in order to prove his supposedly crazy scientific theories - and exact revenge.

programme.title: The Terror : Starring Boris Karloff
programme.desc: A young French soldier cut off from his unit is beguiled by a mysterious woman, whom he learns is the wife of the local Baron - and that she seemingly died twenty years earlier

programme.title: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde Starring John Barrymore
programme.desc: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

programme.title: The Fat Spy
programme.desc: Off the coast of Florida, a nearly-deserted island is rumored to have the fountain of youth. A boatload of teenage kids are headed there for a scavenger hunt.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: In Tulsa, after a rancher dies during a feud with a major oil company, his daughter, driven by revenge, starts digging for oil herself.

programme.title: Oliver Twist
programme.desc: An orphan boy in 1830s London is abused in a workhouse, then falls into the clutches of a gang of thieves.

programme.title: Identity Unknown
programme.desc: An amnesiac soldier, the only survivor of a group of four unidentified soldiers - victims of a bomb raid - visits each man's address with the hope of restoring his memory and identity

programme.title: My Name Is Bruce
programme.desc: A goofy Korean finds his life hopelessly complicated with people continually confusing him with Bruce Lee.

programme.title: City Ninja
programme.desc: A tournament fighter becomes involved in the search for a valuable pendant.

programme.title: Weapons of Death
programme.desc: A police commissioner tries to bring a gangster to justice as the kingpin's out-of-control crimes set even his own underworld allies against him.

programme.title: The Doll Squad
programme.desc: A squad of beautiful government agents chase saboteurs

programme.title: Enforcer From Death Row
programme.desc: A death row inmate is deployed to crush a deadly spy ring

programme.title: Bruce Tuan 7 Promise
programme.desc: Honest, skilled but naive young man journeys to meet his bride-to-be, as arranged by their families, but encounters obstacles from several fronts along the way, including the manipulations of the Green Dragon gang.

programme.title: Kung fu From Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: The gates of hell open to let out the ghosts of the dead Chun Sing is visited by his deceased father, who tells the young man that his enemy is a priest who commands the dark forces of black magic. Luckily, Chun Sing gets help from a magic book, a group of friendly ghosts, and a house full of hookers.

programme.title: Wolf Devil Woman
programme.desc: A woman who was raised by wolves seeks revenge on Red Devil, the villain who ordered the murder of her parents.

programme.title: Invincible Obsessed Fighter . 1982
programme.desc: A man (Mike Wong) helps Gen. Ching's daughter recover stolen treasure on the Chang River.

programme.title: TNT Jackson
programme.desc: A young karate expert searches for her brother's killer in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Black Cobra 2
programme.desc: Chicago cop Robert Malone (Fred Williamson) finds himself in The Philippines, ostensibly to learn the techniques of Interpol. Before he exits the Manila airport, his wallet is stolen by a pickpocket.

programme.title: 2 Great Cavaliers.mp4
programme.desc: After a gang of Manchu killers murder John Liu's fiancée and terrorize everyone in search of the Ming dynasty list of rebels, Liu and Angela Mao team up to fight the Manchus side by side in this rarely seen old school classic.

programme.title: The Executioner ii karate Inferno
programme.desc: A former police captain recruits a group of deadly murderers to remove the corrupt and mafia Yakuza . Their first task is to intercept a briefcase from a band that trafficked drugs.

programme.title: Master of the Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: After his students are killed by the One Armed Boxer, a vengeful and blind Kung Fu expert travels to a village where a martial arts contest is being held and vows to behead every one armed man he comes across.

programme.title: Drunken Tai Chi
programme.desc: A spoiled young man - on the run from a ruthless killer - hooks up with a puppeteer and his wife who are masters of the art of tai chi; the only style that can defeat the killer.

programme.title: Úrsula Corberó y Chino Darin son puro fuego I Brujas de Zugarramurdi I Ministerio de brujas
programme.desc: Bienvenidas al Ministerio de Brujas, donde cada martes a las 20h en Canal Barro, se enciende la hoguera y se queman verdades incómodas. En este episodio, Carlos inauguró la nueva Subsecretaría de Misterios, trayendo algunas de las historias más oscuras y fascinantes de España: Las brujas de Zugarramurdi. La Inquisición y sus castigos. Y esos misterios que siguen latiendo entre cuevas, sombras y supersticiones. Como siempre, en la hoguera ardieron muchas cosas: – Reglas imposibles. – Gente manipuladora que tensa la cuerda. – Vampiros energéticos y demás criaturas emocionales. Pero el clímax llegó cuando las brujas leyeron las cartas astrales de Úrsula Corberó y Chino Darín en vivo. Él, con gen de líder pero alma aniñada y sexy. Ella, fuego puro, control y magnetismo. Juntos, una conexión casi kármica y familiar. Además, se destacó en el Departamento de Archivos Clasificados a una nueva bruja ilustre: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, la voz que hechiza desde el feminismo y la palabra. Y para cerrar con placer y picardía, en la Secretaría de Venus en Tanga, hubo tarot erótico: deseo, destino y mucha, mucha energía ardiente.

programme.title: Claudia Luchetti abre portales en vivo | La decodificadora más famosa en Ministerio de Brujas
programme.desc: En este nuevo capítulo del Ministerio de Brujas, las ministras del zodiaco reciben a una invitada especial: Claudia Luchetti, la decodificadora más famosa de Argentina, una mujer que camina entre la neurociencia, la Kábbalah y la energía invisible. Coach, conferencista y bruja de luz, Claudia nos cuenta cómo llega a ser bruja, qué siente cuando baja información, y cuáles fueron los casos más paranormales que vivió acompañando a otros en su transformación. Además, en esta edición:

programme.title: Ministerio de Brujas: el primer gobierno astral de la historia #astrologia #esoterismo #tarot
programme.desc: Bienvenidas, bienvenidos y bienvenides al Ministerio de Brujas, el nuevo programa del Canal Barro donde la intuición, el arte y la magia se sientan a la misma mesa. Este primer episodio es un aquelarre de verdad: fuego, deseo, política, feminismo y mucho humor. Las ministras @chongazen, @marianaenvozalta y @zakurapill abren las puertas del ministerio con un comunicado oficial: “El Ministerio de Brujas no es un edificio ni un expediente. Es un estado de ánimo. Es ese rincón donde las brujas nos reunimos para decir lo que nadie dice, para reírnos de lo serio y darle seriedad a lo que parece una pavada.” En este primer encuentro: - Protocolo de la Hoguera: adiós a los políticos, los alquileres imposibles, los machirulos, los vampiros energéticos y los hombres de Cáncer. Todo lo que sobra… se quema y se transmuta. - Secretaría de Venus en Tanga: astrología y erotismo sin censura. ¿Qué energía nos mueve en esta luna llena de Aries? - Boletín Oficial de Movimientos Planetarios: ChongaZen trae el parte astrológico del cielo y sus efectos terrenales. - Departamento de Estrellas y Sábanas: compatibilidades cósmicas. Hoy: Penélope Cruz y Javier Bardem. - Dirección de Cinematografía Zodiazal: la Dra. Fernanda Garrido recomienda películas según los elementos zodiacales. - Archivos Clasificados de Brujas: homenaje a Violeta Parra, la artista chilena que convirtió su dolor en himno y su rebeldía en legado eterno. Aquí no hay jerarquías ni jefes: mandan las palabras, la energía y la conexión. Si entraste, ya eres parte del aquelarre.

programme.title: Hablemos claro de la menopausia con Celia Sancho en Matronas al Rescate.
programme.desc: Bienvenida a Matronas al Rescate, el programa donde se habla claro, se ríe fuerte y se normaliza lo que nadie quiere nombrar. En este episodio, las matronas se enfrentan a un tema que llega antes de lo que crees: la menopausia y la perimenopausia. programme.title: Every River Has a Story
programme.desc: As the Quesnel River runs through the Cariboo region of British Columbia, it’s comparable to Jekyll and Hyde. The river that leaves the lake is slow and meandering - it’s a forgiving stream. If a fly angler misplaces a fly while casting from the drift boat, there’s time to pick up and hit the water again. After a few miles, the river transforms into a powerful and erosive agent moving quickly through the sparsely inhabited region. In this episode, Fly Fusion Magazine editor Derek Bird, along with associate editor Jim McLennan, have to adjust their angling tactics in order to successfully fool the strong resident rainbows.

programme.title: Until We Meet Again- Oregon Turkey Hunt with Rick Carone
programme.desc: Success afield is marked by many things- the only one that truly matters is enjoying the outdoors and the experience with the people that we love. In the latest episode of Pursue The Wild, Kristy Titus hunts turkeys in Oregon celebrating friendship and sharing her final hunt with her beloved friend Rick Carone. Armed with the God given gift of leadership and the ability to inspire the hearts of all who meet him, Rick Carone, lived purposefully and passionately. At the age of 42, Rick faced head on a diagnosis of Pancreatic Cancer. The doctors gave Rick statistics that offered him a 15% chance of surviving beyond year one, but Rick was not one to let adversity and challenge slow him down. Brought to his knees by his diagnosis, Rick found the strength to stand up and fight with the power of his self-proclaimed triple threat of attack on cancer, Faith, Family and Friends. With a God given purpose, Rick shared his incredible personal story with the nation- he inspired the dreams and hopes of others touching the most important landscape- our hearts, helping to raise awareness and helping the fight to shut down cancer. After a four year battle, on June 29th, Rick Carone was called home. He did not lose his battle with cancer, he used his battle to leave a legacy that will now be carried on by the friends that loved him. To continue Rick's fight to shut down cancer go to www.teamcarone.com.

programme.desc: Danjuma’s job is on the line and he would get fired if he doesn’t do the will of his boss. But he can’t compromise his conscience and ethics and he can’t afford to lose his job.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Prenup: Drama
programme.desc: Uche is avoiding Justice Babatunde and everyone in the house. Shade is with her dad and Soji is trying to share Uche up. Justice Babatunde and uche had an argument about get the prenup nullified, but Justice Babatunde said he can't do it, and collapsed after Uche walked out on him.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Crossroads
programme.desc: GBard, Soji’s superstar friend, came around, and the girls and paparazzi went gaga over him but he came with a legal issue they never saw coming. Sade is facing some difficulties in her career. She leans to her stepmother. The duo learn that documents are meant to be read.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Meet My Woman
programme.desc: Buchi and Danjuma tease Papa about his age and single status, so Papa tells them about Vicky, his girlfriend, the daughter of a rich father who he later introduced to them.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Oleku
programme.desc: Papa is in the living room keeping the records of Shege's ladies. He kept a special one for himself called Portia. Portia suddenly turned herself into a housewife immediately and started giving orders to everyone. The situation became unbearable for Shege, and he must find a way to send her away. They brought an idea of fumigation, that everyone would have to leave the house for two days, an opportunity Shege used to escape her only for Portia to come back the next day with the fumigation kits.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 It's A No
programme.desc: Tare is finding it very hard to believe her husband’s decision and support it. She expresses her disagreement and refuses to support his decision. Garba, her husband’s driver, would not stop coming to the house and as much as she tries, her sister Sotonye, who is living with them hears the resignation news.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 The Godfather
programme.desc: Voke invited Bob the magician to a house party. Bob performed some magic and Papa didn't believe him until he performed another magic. Papa decided to be a magician he told Bob to teach him how to do magic. Papa performed a magic on Voke, which turned him into a rabbit. He performed the magic again but Voke didn't come as him.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Not Too Young To Love
programme.desc: Soji is feeling sad because his father would not approve of their relationship but Uche steps in and love wins

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Welcome Miss Amanda
programme.desc: Danjuma leaves the apartment to further his education. Sege brought a friend’s sister to squat with them for her NYSC.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Shade is not happy with everyone in the house because she thought they forgot her birthday, now they all have to figure out what she wants for her birthday gift. They all came up with different ideas, but only Soji was able to figure it out. Shade wanted to see her dream music artist, STYL PLUS

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Shades Of Love
programme.desc: A strange love affair between Pero and Sade ensues. He even proposed to her and Sade was ready to leave the house with him since nobody supported their love. But when something is unbelievable and too good to be true, it usually isn’t

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Deliverance
programme.desc: Papa’s mum came visiting despite Papa’s manipulation for her not to come. She decides to go spiritual about his refusal to get married and brings in a prophet.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Things Fall Apart
programme.desc: Papa met with an old friend Femi in a bar who was planning on going to the Third Mainland Bridge to jump over the bridge because of his life issues, while Papa was also considering doing so. Shege showed up. He told him he had been looking for him. Shege brought him to the new apartment. They agreed not to take in new squatters. Papa took pictures he posted on the internet, which opened an opportunity for the new squatters. Danjuma asked them to help his sister, Aliyah, a banker, to be with them in the house then, two other people came in immediately: Voke Papa's nephew and Chinwe, his neighbor. Voke and Chinwe are social media influencers. The three of them had to come together to save their stay in the house.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Three And Half Men
programme.desc: Tosin, Buchi’s baby mama, dropped their son, Yinka, with him because she was traveling. Yinka’s first week with Buchi proves to be tougher than it was imagined.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Am Getting Jealous
programme.desc: Justice Babatunde's millionaire friend David Jones, came to visit him. He wanted to do an event, Justice Babatunde mentioned to him that his daughter, Sade, is an event planner. He took Sade out and she got the best treatment of her life. She came home and started explaining everything to her boyfriend Prince, only for the boy to be very upset. Prince became jealous till he was rude to Mr. David Jones, well, the truth came out that he was genuinely buy things for Sade without any hidden intentions.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Rats
programme.desc: Things started disappearing in the apartment, and everyone is a suspect. They think there is a ghost in the house.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Fond Memories
programme.desc: Uche, Soji, and Sade are together talking about the good time they all had together.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Life For Rent
programme.desc: A millionaire blogger contracts Raymond to be her fake boyfriend to deceive her mother. Papa, Sege and Dorothy are party to this deal but they forgot to inform the real players: Kaffy and Rachel

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Maintain Your Lane
programme.desc: Buchi learns a new vice visiting the pool joint every night, and he always wins. Sureboy challenges him to a face-off and wins, then Buchi realizes Papa betrays him in the game.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 The 40th Birthday
programme.desc: It is Tokunbo Martins’s 40th birthday, and against his will, his wife, Tare Martins, throws him a surprise party. But he is unhappy about this and worried about something else. He wants to quit his job as a Bank Manager to follow his dream of being a livestock farmer

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Education Is The Best Legacy
programme.desc: Sege and his brother had a huge fallout. Sege refuses to complete his education because, according to him, school has nothing to offer him. Sege later got a bitter experience that made him rethink his decision and go back to school.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Wild Wild Love
programme.desc: Dorothy got a call from home that her father was sick and had to leave. Papa brings another woman home and a huge mix-up happens all thanks to Raymond’s vlog that left Dorothy with no choice than to rush back.

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Estate Chairman
programme.desc: The chairmanship election for the estate is on, and each house gets a form and a lot of other juicy benefits. The squatters fight tooth and nail to be the one to contest and even outsmart each other, but they keep it from Sege who is the owner of the house and who should contest.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Mistress Of None
programme.desc: Sotonye takes a catering job to make small chops for an event. She relied on YouTube and Garba’s assistance and would not listen to her sister’s advice to hire a professional caterer. She flops, and the client threatens to arrest her if she does not do a refund.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 Family From Another Planet
programme.desc: In the same weekend, Tare’s dramatic and spiritual auntie Aunty Dewari and Tokunbo’s talkative cousin Dewale visits and makes the house a living hell for everyone.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Buchi And The Popular Artist
programme.desc: Buchi pretends to be a music producer to get the girls to keep coming to him, he could not keep the act for long as he was exposed and paid dearly for it.

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Covet Your Neighbor's Property/Babe
programme.desc: Danjuma, an old squatter and friend of the house, decided to come visiting. Papa was filled with joy and couldn’t wait to have him. But the coming of Danjuma brings with it a huge threat to Papa’s underlying likeness for Dorothy as Danjuma begins to flirt with her.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 How I Met Your Mother
programme.desc: Papa’a mother came again and this time all the squatters left the house so she wouldn’t meet them at home. She meets Esiri and realized their initial meeting was just a fluke. They get to know each other and a flirting relationship starts to everyone especially Papa’s disgust. Meanwhile, Sege is still looking for the missing Rachel.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Greencard
programme.desc: Buchi’s prayers to travel out of Nigeria seem about to be answered when Sureboy mentioned he is a traveling agent. Buchi invested all his money into Sureboy’s agency and even agreed to a fake marriage with an American citizen to make his traveling process faster while he prepares to leave the country.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 No Work At Home
programme.desc: Uche’s aunt came to visit and gave them the treat on their lives but she had a hidden agenda. But nothing beats the union of a family.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Deliverance
programme.desc: Papa’s mum came visiting despite Papa’s manipulation for her not to come. She decides to go spiritual about his refusal to get married and brings in a prophet.

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Allow Any Fradulent Activity In The House
programme.desc: Raymond stole Dorothy’s money and invested it in a money scheme. Sureboy brought the ‘Double the money scheme’, and he cashed out on it. He shared the testimony with Papa, who also cashed out. Sege got wind of it and was also convinced since Papa and Raymond cashed out and decided to invest millions After all what is good for the goose is good for the gander.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Breaking News
programme.desc: Justice Tunde Abiola fell in love with his nurse Uche, and decided to marry her. He introduces her to his children, who were not going to have any of it as they devise schemes to destroy the union.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 The Bridge
programme.desc: After losing the investment deal and facing the loss of their house, Tokunbo becomes dejected and shuts himself out from the world, and will not come out to see his family. Tare runs again to his mother to help her reach him. In the midst of this, Tare takes a huge leap regarding her government job.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Surrogate Part2
programme.desc: Uche is shattered. She lost her baby and has to deal with the aftermath of this event. She wants another one but her husband is too busy and this causes more issues between them.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Sidechick
programme.desc: The squatters came back from a journey and met a strange woman on their couch. Sege gives her a type of preferential treatment that poses a threat to his relationship with Rachel. The male squatters grow a liking to her and this does not go down well with Dorothy.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Insult To Injury
programme.desc: Esiri gets into trouble with the squatters because of his clumsiness, and they beat the hell out of him. He became incapacitated for too long, and it was beginning to look fake. How do they expose him?? His weakness…

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 London Tailor
programme.desc: Still in her discipline season, Sotonye overhears Grandma needed a tailor to sew her cloth for her friend’s daughter's wedding. She volunteers and, after assuring Grandma that she will do something excellent and, in her words, ‘shock her,’ she did exactly that.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Buchi And Yinka
programme.desc: Buchi long distant girlfriend calls him to say that she was in town and mentions the name ‘Yinka’ in their conversation. Buchi becomes disturbed as to who Yinka is. Is she cheating?

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Greencard Part2
programme.desc: All that glitters is not gold, Buchi is about to learn this the very hard way.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Squatterz And The Old Man
programme.desc: Papa teaches Buchi to be nice to people and respect his elders. Buchi misinterprets this and brings a strange man home in a bid to be nice. He refuses to leave despite his intolerable habits.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Hot Candles
programme.desc: Esiri brings a money deal that sounded irresistible to Buchi, all he had to do is swallow a new pill in the market by a new pharmaceutical company. Buchi is totally bought over since money is involved; he refuses to listen to the voice of critics. But were they right? Is this Buchi’s big breakthrough?

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Life For Rent
programme.desc: A millionaire blogger contracts Raymond to be her fake boyfriend to deceive her mother. Papa, Sege and Dorothy are party to this deal but they forgot to inform the real players: Kaffy and Rachel

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Episode 5 - Stockholm
programme.desc: Peder Fredricson is standing in the top of the Longines Global Champions Tour 2021 rankings this year, however things can change quickly during the fifth leg in Stockholm. The Global Champions Tour Grand Prix of Stockholm disputed in the Olympic Stadium will prove to be a test like no other.Watch the 2021 LGCT Stockholm competition.

programme.title: Global Champions League - Episode 5 - Stockholm
programme.desc: Stockholm is hosting the fifth leg of the GCL 2021 edition. The Swedish capital has set the Olympic Stadium as the chosen venue for this clash of titans. Previously, Paris Panthers had its first win of the tournament in Valkenswaard. Will they be able to repeat this success in Stockholm?Watch the best moments of the CSI5* 1.55M GCL 2021 edition in its fifth leg.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Dos Lunas Polo Club vs Evviva Polo Saint-Moritz
programme.desc: Dos Lunas Polo Club is facing Evviva Polo Saint-Moritz in this heated game at the Polo Rider Cup 2021. Playing with a 10/12 goals handicap and 5 chukkers, both teams will try their best to keep advancing in the tournament, but it will not be an easy feat. Watch the best moments of the competition.

programme.title: Warwickshire Cup - Final Lovelocks vs Monterosso Vikings
programme.desc: The Warwickshire Cup, organized by Cirencester Park Polo Club, is one of the most prestigious events in the English high handicap. Teams of 4 people compete in this event to raise above their heads the Cup. At the end, only a team can remain. Don't miss out on the 2020 final of Lovelocks vs. Monterosso Vikings.

programme.title: CHIO Aachen - Best Moments
programme.desc: Words speak for themselves. An equestrian show unrivalled anywhere in the world, offering the highest level of performance. The CHIO Aachen is probably the most prestigious horse show in Europe when it comes to show jumping and dressage. Riders compete against each other in this episode for victory in the show jumping competition. Relive all the magic moments of the 2019 edition of the CHIO Aachen.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 3 - Teams on Top
programme.desc: Team jumping competitions started in 1909, and in 1929 FEI created the Nations Cup. Since, the sport has evolved to become a dynamic competition. In this episode, we will look back at some of most iconic wins in the FEI Jumping Nations Cup. Watch how it has evolved from its military background to the electrifying sport we watch today.

programme.title: Campus Life Experience - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the first episode of Campus Life Experience, we are in Umbria ready to meet our students: Lorenzo, Margherita, Michelangelo, Elena, Michela, Caterina, Giacomo, Alessandra, Alessandro and Larissa. They are about to ride into a new challenge and learn everything about their equine friends. Come join us!

programme.title: New York - Vendée Transatlantic Race
programme.desc: This single-handed yacht race will cross the Northern Atlantic through two symbolic cities: New York and Sables d’Olonne. The departure from the Big Apple represents a cosmopolitan crossroad of influences, as well as the cradle of the IMOCA Class, while the arrival in the Sables d’Olonne means landing in the Old Continent after days or weeks of harsh conditions.After crossing a risky and challenging course straight through the middle of the “iceberg alley”, the skippers will arrive in the heart of the Vendée Globe considered as the “Everest of the Sea”. The Transatlantic race is the final event of the IMOCA Globe Series and it allows racers to build their hard racing miles. It represents a further opportunity to reinforce its image as a marine region, thus it is an awaited event for all those sailors thinking about embarking on the Vendée Globe.Follow their journey from New York to Sables d’Olonne in New York – Vendée Transatlantic Race. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep3
programme.desc: We invite you to discover and remember the best moments in "A day at the Barcelona International Boat Show".During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the sunny French Riviera for the 2016 Cannes Yachting Festival, a gathering in the name of luxury and excellence. In this year's edition, more than 200 models will be shown for the first time ever in the world. Let's find out the highlights of this incredible boat show.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever. In this episode of Sail-Ho, we will be exploring this charming island.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island. programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, we are in the TwinTip open Worlds in Hangloose beach, Italy where Florian Gruber has defended his title for the 3rd time! Then, we are set to join the Kite World Series in China’s Weifang and Pingtan where the fastest foilers are ready to set new records in kite foiling. We finish our journey at the final of the series that took place in Cagliari, Italy where Maxim Nocher has been crowned Champion of the series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we will focus on the action around the 2019 Kite Foil World Series, which is composed by four non-discard events. This means that all the event scores will be counted. The series began in Gizzeria, Italy and will head to China’s Pingtan and Weifang in September for two successive, action packed events before concluding in Cagliari, Italy. With the latter being the place where the male and female of 2019 Kite Foil World Champions will be crowned.

programme.title: Semaine Du Golfe Du Morbihan
programme.desc: The Semaine du Golfe Du Morbihan is an essential event for all classic sailing lovers. The Gulf Week is a maritime even set on the beautiful Morbihan Gulf, in Brittany, a French destination known for its gorgeous landscape. Expending on 35000 hectares, it is worth is reputation as the little sea. For one week, the Gulf will be letting more than 1000 ships rip through its waters. Rowing boats, lightships, classic sailing ships... almost 6000 sailors will take part in this year's edition. This joyful week has been organised in order to meet and share new experiences, so let's enduge in the best moments, most impressive boats and latest news of the 7th edition of the Semaine du Golfe Du Morbihan!

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep3
programme.desc: We invite you to discover and remember the best moments in "A day at the Barcelona International Boat Show".During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the sunny French Riviera for the 2016 Cannes Yachting Festival, a gathering in the name of luxury and excellence. In this year's edition, more than 200 models will be shown for the first time ever in the world. Let's find out the highlights of this incredible boat show.

programme.title: New York - Vendée Transatlantic Race
programme.desc: This single-handed yacht race will cross the Northern Atlantic through two symbolic cities: New York and Sables d’Olonne. The departure from the Big Apple represents a cosmopolitan crossroad of influences, as well as the cradle of the IMOCA Class, while the arrival in the Sables d’Olonne means landing in the Old Continent after days or weeks of harsh conditions.After crossing a risky and challenging course straight through the middle of the “iceberg alley”, the skippers will arrive in the heart of the Vendée Globe considered as the “Everest of the Sea”. The Transatlantic race is the final event of the IMOCA Globe Series and it allows racers to build their hard racing miles. It represents a further opportunity to reinforce its image as a marine region, thus it is an awaited event for all those sailors thinking about embarking on the Vendée Globe.Follow their journey from New York to Sables d’Olonne in New York – Vendée Transatlantic Race. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 4
programme.desc: The race course of Riva del Garda is well-known for its dramatic cliff face and 1000m mountain peaks on its west shore as well as the typically strong wind and flat-water conditions. It’s the 5th time Lake Garda has hosted the foiling catamarans as part of the GC32 Racing Tour. The heavyweight battle at the top of the leaderboard was between the Adam Minoprio-skippered Oman Air and Ernesto Bertarelli’s Alinghi, helmed this week by Swiss ace Arnaud Psarofaghis. These two teams sit on the top of the leaderboard on equal points after 3 of the 5 events this season. Heading into the Riva del Garda event, holding third were the Austrian Olympic Tornado double gold medallists Roman Hagara and Hans-Peter Steinacher and their Red Bull Sailing Team. In this episode, we dive into the action of the GC32 Racing Tour in Riva.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez - Meetings at St Tropez
programme.desc: Les Voiles de St Tropez Regatta is the closing event of the summer season in St Tropez and the Riviera. For the 2017 edition of this event, over 300 of the most amazing sailing yachts from all over the world - classic and modern - plus 3500 crew, unite in St Tropez for a week of racing and festivities. Join us on Nautical Channel for the latest action at Les Voiles de Saint Tropez!

programme.desc: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show’s opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world!

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 9
programme.desc: This is the final episode of the season and we want to end with a big finale. This is why we have comedian Mike Rita on tonight's episode. He has quickly branded himself as one of Canada's top comedic performers, and his writing can be heard on Vice TV. Let's hit the water with Mike!

programme.title: Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 2
programme.desc: For this second episode of Maxiboat, we will discover a new French shipyard specialized in eco-responsible sailing catamarans: Windelo catamaran. Also, we will be updated on the construction of the Ultim racing multihulls, the giants of the seas that will participate in the next offshore races. Also on the agenda, sea trials on the BWA and Marshall range of rib boats.

programme.desc: We set sail to a new adventure in this episode of Jump on Board. After leaving the romantic island of Syros behind, we head for Paros, a renowned island, rich with culture and beautiful nature. We will be dropping the anchor and taking a tour. Come join us!

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Yellow Flickers
programme.desc: Do the lines in the road countdown to a supposed arrival? Or are they added up within us, allowing us to grow?

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: NowHere
programme.desc: A 2010 winter journey with riders facing harsh conditions and deeper questions. This Absinthe Films documentary explores perception, purpose, and the fine line between feeling lost and finding where you truly belong.

programme.title: Flipside - NowHere Episode 1
programme.desc: Flipside is the show that takes you behind the scenes with Absinthe Films during the making of our latest snowboard movie - NowHere. Follow the life and times of a handful of the most progressive and entertaining riders in snowboarding. Our 2010 Flipside series is broadcasted in 10-12 minute webisodes on various websites including Transworld Snowboarding, MPORA and Swatch as well as on absinthe-films.com

programme.title: Evo Explores: Kimmy Fasani
programme.desc: Over the course of her career, snowboarder Kimmy Fasani has won the coveted “Women’s Rider of The Year Award” from TransWorld Snowboarding Magazine, and the “Women’s Video Part of The Year Award” from Snowboarder Magazine. This fascinating documentary captures Fasani’s first time riding in Alaska.

programme.title: Evo Explores: Brandon Cocard
programme.desc: An early morning of magic in Haines, Alaska with the Absinthe Films crew. Featuring: Brandon Cocard Kimmy Fasani, Nicolas Müller

programme.title: Echo Chamber
programme.desc: In 2020, Brandon Cocard dropped “Echo Chamber,” featuring cameos from Miles Fallon, Kazu Kokubo, Taylor Elliott, Brendon Rego, Kevin Backstrom, Mike Rav, Kaede Yasunaga, Keisuke Yoshida and Chris Beresford. Filmed in Hokkaido, Japan and Salt Lake City, Utah by Sam Tuor. Music by Cocard and friends.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Nippow Holiday
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen invites the filmmaker and musician, Leo Cittadella, to join him and Rip Zinger on a powder trip to Hokkaido, Japan. Along the way, they meet up with Nicolas Müller and Mikkel Bang to film for the Absinthe Films feature "TurboDojo.”

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo One
programme.desc: On his 45th trip to Japan (since 1991), Terje rides powder in the Japanese Alps with the snowboarders Leo Cittadella, Rip Zinger, Curtis Ciszek, Oli Gittler and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Two
programme.desc: The snowboarders Rip Zinger and Terje Haakonsen ride powder in Japan. Years after his recovery from a debilitating head injury, they get Kevin Pearce back on snow. Join us for this episode of friendship, freshies, and freeriding.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Three
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen explores the joys of Japanese mountain culture with his friends Kevin Pearce, Mikkel Bang, Rip Zinger, Oli Gittler, Curtis Ciszek, Leo Cittadella and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Relax If You Can
programme.desc: Terje Haakonsen and Leo Cittadella go snowskating at the vast Austrian ski resort of Ischgl. While enjoying a timeout along the Swiss-Austrian border, they discuss European cultural differences and similarities.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Half Banked at Mt Baker
programme.desc: Terje and Leo Cittadella head to Mt. Baker, Washington to meet up with with Russell Winfield and Rip Zinger to compete in the 33rd Legendary Banked Slalom. During a windstorm, a tree falls on the house while everyone is asleep. Terje gets waxing tips from Olympic gold medalist Seth Westcott.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Attunga - A Higher Place
programme.desc: An intimate portrait of three Norwegian snowboarders: legendary purist Terje Haakonsen, holistic-minded Torgeir Bergrem, and carefree wunderkind Marcus Kleveland. Watch as filmmaker and snowboarder Seth Huot pulls back the curtain to examine their common purpose, potential, pitfalls, and paychecks.

programme.title: Artist Profile - José Medeles
programme.desc: For most artists, music is a way of life. On this episode of the Artist Profile series, we follow José Medeles through a day in the life as he shares his journey from La Salle, Illinois to touring with The Breeders, to founding the Revival Drum Shop and making music as one half of 1939 Ensemble.

programme.title: Marmoset Presents: Bridge City Revival
programme.desc: Bridge City Revival is the acclaimed music collective from Portland, Oregon. Inspired by the soulful 60s, BCR was raised on The Chi-Lites, Otis Redding, Isley Brothers, Lee Fields, and Sharon Jones. Banger drum breaks. Driving bass. Rhythmic guitar. Rolling keyboards. Soulful brass. That’s BCR!

programme.title: Artist Profile - WebsterX
programme.desc: In this episode, we focus our cameras on the hip-hop artist WebsterX as he prepares for his hometown performance at the summer TDM Festival in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. FIlmed by Josh Brine and Kale Chesney.

programme.title: Visitations - La Sera: Devil’s Hearts Grow Gold
programme.desc: La Sera performing "Devils Hearts Grow Gold" at Room 205. A few days before embarking on their first UK tour, mastermind Katy Goodman (vox/bass), Jennifer Prince (guitar/vox), and Jonathan Weil (drums), stopped by to blast through a few songs from Katy's upcoming full-length on Hardly Art.

programme.title: Visitations - La Sera: Never Come Around
programme.desc: La Sera performing 'Never Come Around' at Room 205. A few days before embarking on their first UK tour, La Sera stopped by Room 205 to play songs from the band’s upcoming LP on Hardly Art. The project's inspiration springs from an attraction to ethereal choral vocals and pop hits of the 1950's.

programme.title: Atoms and Void - Lay Down Your Weapons
programme.desc: “Lay Down Your Weapons” is a respite from the cacophony of the world. Atoms and Void is musician Arlie Carstens, of Seattle’s Juno, and producer Eric Fisher. Known for his skateboarding films, Director Greg Hunt here lets landscapes and cityscapes slowly unfold. Breathe deeply, watch and listen.

programme.title: Atoms and Void - Waves Of Blood
programme.desc: The core of Atoms and Void is formed in the friendship and songwriting partnership of Arlie Carstens and Eric Fisher. “Waves of Blood” features cartwheeling post-rock guitars, buoyant bass, and double-drummers bashing away like shutters in a hurricane. Good for long walks and red-eye flights.

programme.title: Atoms and Void - This Departing Landscape
programme.desc: Atoms and Void is formed in the songwriting partnership of Arlie Carstens and Eric Fisher. The video for the song, “This Departing Landscape,” is an awkwardly beautiful collection of footage from years of touring and recording, proving the maxim, “life is about the journey, not the destination.”

programme.title: Atoms and Void - Golden Shivers
programme.desc: Atoms and Void is formed in the songwriting partnership of Arlie Carstens and Eric Fisher. “Golden Shivers” is a beautiful piece of ambient electronic music akin to the works of minimalist composers Steve Reich and Meredith Monk. Good for running, dancing, driving, and doing the dishes. Play loud.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Futureproof
programme.desc: In shred world, Absinthe Films’ "Futureproof" is widely regarded as a stone cold classic. This movie showcases iconic performances from many of the best riders to ever do it, including Romain De Marchi, JP Solberg, Trevor Andrew Wolfgang Nyvelt and Gigi Rüf.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Brighton Resort - Episode 01
programme.desc: In our latest MICRODOSE series we aim to explore the most influential resorts and iconic locations in snowboarding history, starting with—that’s right—Brighton Resort in Salt Lake City, Utah. Welcome to Brighton Resort Episode 1 of 5. For many riders young and old, Brighton Resort will forever be the epicenter of the snowboarding world. The plentiful snowfall, terrain parks, lift ops, cat drivers, mechanics, management, cafeteria, cooks, and mountain culture are all first class. Back in the early days, very few ski resorts were willing to take a chance on the newfound “lifestyle sport” of snowboarding, but Brighton took the leap. In doing so, Brighton made all the difference. Within a few years, hundreds of ski areas around the world came to see Brighton’s approach to snowboarding as the gold standard. From the biggest vacation destinations to the smallest trash heaps covered in fake snow, everyone (whether they’ve known it or not) has borrowed from the Brighton playbook. This has made it possible for millions of would-be snowboarders to make their first turns safely in-bounds via rope-tows, chairlifts, and gondola rides. Newbies need not traipse into the backcountry with no snow sense and little skill. For this we have Brighton to thank.

programme.title: Wash'Dup
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this mockumentary film will follow a group of ex- snowboard filmmakers and ex-pro riders who never hung it up. Still in love with the sport and fueled by mid life crisis, these shred for lifers are extremely vulnerable to delusions of grandeur. But the dream is always “still alive” in their minds. In turn they ignore all the red flags and continue to do what seems completely irrational to everyone except for them. After a 16 year hiatus, they irresponsibly put their adult obligations behind, and join a pact to make just one last movie. But they are missing a solid presence of youth to make their movie marketable. As a remedy they end up filming with riders that span 2 generations. This unlikely alliance leads them to discover much more about snowboarding and themselves by living the snowboarding dream through an ageless lens. Filled with sketch comedy skits, this film expresses the nuanced story of a young sport reaching a level of maturity the current industry now begins to embrace. From the death of the snowboard shop, and extinction of film media, to the old pro struggling to find their way in life after the glory days are long gone, WashDup is a story that finally needs to be told.

programme.title: Hook Down, Wheels Down
programme.desc: Produced in the early 1970s, "Hook Down, Wheels Down" was one of the most comprehensive (and expensive) films made by the U.S. Navy. It covers the history and development of the U.S. aircraft carrier, and does so through interviews with many of the men who made it happen. While dozens of aircraft carriers are featured, it is the USS John F. Kennedy (CV-67) that takes center stage -- and the material shot on her deck looks like it is right out of "Top Gun". There is wonderful flight op footage, great aerial flight footage, incredible WWII dog fightand bombing footage as well as endless aircraft carrier operational footage. Also shown in this film are very rare images of the first aircraft carrier USS Langley (CV-1) (formerly collier USS Jupiter AC-3). The follow on vessels are widely featured including USS Lexington (CV-3) and the USS Yorktown (CV-5) in the Battle of Coral Sea. Also featured: USS Saratoga (CV-2), USS Enterprise (CV-6), USS Hornet (CV-8), USS Wasp (CV-7), USS Ranger (CV-4), USS Yorktown (CV-5), USS Essex (CV-9), USS Guadalcanal (CVE-60), the British carrier HMS Furious, the destroyer USS Zeilin (DD-313), and many other warships. Various incidents are shown from Pearl Harbor, Midway, Coral Sea, the capture of the submarine U-505, the Marianas Turkey Shoot, the Doolittle Raid on Japan, and more. Includes interviews or appearances by many WWII naval aviators and aces including Wade McClusky, John Jay Courtney, Billy Mitchell, Gerald Bogen, Leslie Generes, John S. Thatch (of "Thatch Weave" fame), Ensign George Gay, David Campbell (whose Minsi III appears in the film), Edward "Butch" O'Hare, Charles Lindbergh, Glenn Curtiss, Clark Gable and Wallace Beery. Planes seen in the film include the Wright Brothers flier, biplanes, Lindbergh's Spirit of St. Louis, the NC-4 Flying Boat, Hellcat, Avenger, Corsair, Vindicator, Devastator, Wildcat, and Japanese Zero. Also seen in the film: dogfights, combat flying, the Washington Conference on battleships, the Panama Canal exercise of 1929, air mail service.

programme.title: Boom Boom-1936
programme.desc: World War I, apparently. There is a series of quick blackout gags, including a soldier that throws the pin, is blown sky-high by the grenade, and is caught in a net by an ambulance driver; one soldier's encounters with very smart bullets; a machine gunner with the jitters. Porky leads a charge, but with no support from his company, he runs back and dives under Beans' bunk. After a quick chorus of "You're in the Army Now," a messenger pigeon drops in with news that General Hardtack is being held prisoner. They dash off in a motorcycle/sidecar, chased by another smart bullet, and arrive in the nick of time to dispatch the general's captors. They fly off in a plane and get shot down to end up together in the hospital.

programme.title: Out to Punch 1956
programme.desc: Popeye's training for his boxing match with Bluto by jumping rope with a massive chain. Bluto, who's lazy about everything except sabotage, decides he needs to stop Popeye. He fills Popeye's heavy bag with iron junk, but Popeye punches it over the fence onto Bluto. Next, he pulls on the springs attached to the wall with a motorcycle, but Popeye pulls so hard he throws Bluto and the cycle through the building and into a well. Popeye is walking -- or actually, prancing -- behind Olive on the way to the match, so Bluto tries a bit more sabotage: first an oil slick, which slows Popeye down briefly, then some quick-dry cement in a puddle. This gives Popeye cement overshoes, and when he gets to the arena, he's exhausted. Olive stands him up, but Bluto treats him like a punching bag. He's got Popeye on the floor (under the ring), so Olive finally breaks out the spinach. Popeye knocks Bluto through the roof, right into the hospital. The photographers ask for a picture, and Popeye's biceps form the words

programme.title: I Never Changes My Altitude 1937
programme.desc: Popeye is sitting outside Olive's lunchroom at the airport, distraught. She's closed the business to fly away with an aviator (Bluto, of course). But it's hardly what she expected; he has her painting his plane, while it's flying; when she says she's rather go back to Popeye, he tries to throw her off the plane. Popeye sees this, and takes off in a plane, just in time to help her out. The boys get into a dogfight, and Bluto manages to demolish Popeye's plane. As Popeye is falling, he grabs a duck and feeds the duck spinach. The duck manages to fly him up to Bluto's plane, Popeye has some spinach of his own, and he teaches Bluto a lesson. Popeye picks up Olive and crashes the plane into the diner, opening it (and providing a new counter).

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application? Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: CHINA EXPANDS ZERO-TARIFF TO 53 AFRICAN NATIONS
programme.desc: Starting May 1st, China will expand preferential duty-free treatment for all imports from 53 African countries. CGTN host Vivienne Nunis talks to Namibian Minister of International Relations and Trade Selma Ashipala-Musavyi, Professor from Tsinghua University Tang Xiaoyang and Political Analyst Adriel Kasonta from the UK, to find out how the move will boost two-way trade between China and Africa, strengthen Africa's competitiveness in global trade and boost integrity within the continent.
